text: Completed: testkit now provides SchedulerProgram for reusable fixed/failing programs, ScriptedScheduler for ordered capabilities/submit/observe/accounting/cancel expectations and traces, and ScriptedLogReader for ordered full-contract log reads. ScriptedCommandExecutor records policies, can require an exact policy, preserves mismatched steps, and reports mismatch/exhaustion clearly. Removed unused AttemptReplay. Representative local, SSH, managed, and observability suites now consume the public testkit; their test-to-compile edges are justified by imports.
